property_summary: For any vault and asset and any storage state, when block.timestamp <= utilizationData.lastUpdate the reference contract's rate(...) always reads IVault.utilization(...) (and thus is independent of currentUtilizationIndex), whereas the mutant instead reads currentUtilizationIndex and can therefore produce a different returned latestAnswer for some inputs; the test asserts the reference's returned latestAnswer equals the value obtained by calling rate after mocking IVault to return a fixed utilization while varying currentUtilizationIndex, which the mutant will break for some fuzzed inputs.
change_summary: If block.timestamp is not greater than lastUpdate, call currentUtilizationIndex and compute utilization from index difference instead of reading IVault.utilization, altering returned rate for that branch.
